contribution.name: Validated follow-up refs for duplicate-message refusals
contribution.motivation: The official duplicate-message HTTP 422 now places an optional operator-correlation ref token at the end of a long response. The client bounded error text to 500 characters, so it could discard that token, and it had no validated way to attach the token to a genuinely different follow-up request. Its Chinese guidance also still recommended rephrasing, which the updated protocol explicitly discourages.
contribution.summary: Extract only the exact published ref shape from raw 422 text before safe truncation, display it separately, and add an explicit --ref option that validates the token before networking and returns it as a query parameter. Update the Chinese guidance toward specific replies, notes, mailboxes and bridge echo suppression instead of superficial rewrites.

validation.compile_check: agent.py and test_agent.py compiled successfully with an isolated bytecode cache.
validation.ref_checks: Regression tests recover a valid token located beyond the 500-character safe excerpt, reject malformed, uppercase, overlong, prefixed and suffix-appended variants, ignore tokens on non-422 responses, and assert the validated token is encoded on the follow-up request.
validation.deployed_config: The public /config reported version 0.11.4 with a 120-second duplicate window, five accepted copies and a 16-character length floor; none of these deployer-controlled values is hard-coded in the client.
validation.secret_scan: The staged changes and all reachable Git history were checked for identity private values, PEM/private-key material, common credential patterns, sensitive filenames, local absolute paths, and the removed Mandy contributor name; no sensitive match was found.

technocore.verification: The single write returned HTTP 200 with posted sequence 14 and the expected timestamp, and its stored signature was verified locally. A subsequent HTTPS JSONL export contained the matching public DID, exact nonce and timestamp; all 14 records passed strict parsing and reported three current valid signatures plus 11 legacy records without stored signatures. No ref was attached because this contribution was not a follow-up to an actual duplicate refusal.
